title: 第1567章 暗流16第1566章 暗流15
content_zh:
看着他这般避而不谈、全然不愿理会自己的模样，作家站在原地，心底反复斟酌、纠结良久。他清楚此事关乎苍生万物，关乎整个星球的存亡，容不得半点懈怠与纵容，最终还是压下心底的迟疑，上前一步，再度出声打断这份闲适的平静：“可是教授？”
“嗯？”张佛依旧头也未抬，目光依旧牢牢落在缸中游走的鱼群身上，指尖依旧慢条斯理地撒着鱼食，只随意发出一声轻浅的应答，漫不经心，全然没有将作家的顾虑放在心上。
作家见状，再度往前凑近半步，周身的气息彻底沉了下来，神色变得无比郑重严肃，每一个字都咬得清晰有力，带着沉甸甸的警示意味，沉声问道：“倘若你真的成功实施了这个计划，你清清楚楚知道，后续会引发怎样毁灭性的后果，不是吗？”
这句沉甸甸的质问，终于让张佛停下了手中的动作。他缓缓抬眸，抬起头来，目光直直锁定身前的作家，眼底带着几分审视、几分玩味，还有一丝近乎偏执的自信，不紧不慢地反向追问：“那你倒是说说，作家，会发生什么？”
作家深吸一口凉气，胸腔胀满沉郁的凝重，脑海中飞速层层推演这场疯狂计划引发的连锁灾难，心底寒意丛生。他望着眼前自负的男人，语气愈发沉重肃穆，字字诛心：“海量海水骤然涌入地底极致灼热的地核区域，会在瞬间被汽化，化作超高温、超高压的过热蒸汽。地底密闭空间的压力会在短时间内疯狂暴涨、层层叠加，最终彻底冲破岩层极限，硬生生撑裂、崩塌整片地壳。到那时，山川倾覆、大地崩裂、火海滔天、天地剧变，世间所有生灵都会尽数消亡，无一幸免，我们赖以生存的这颗蓝色星球，也会彻底走向崩坏与毁灭。”
（“是的，但是你没有足够大的下水道来容纳海洋。”作家看着这沙盘模型说道。
“那我就做一个。”张佛说道。
作家不解的问：“抱歉，我有些迷惑，地壳有那么厚，在那下面被认为是一个白热的熔融核心。那你要把海洋弄去哪里？”
张佛得意的说道：“这是我的秘密。”
“哦，你在拿我开心，教授。”作家假意的道。
“不不。”张佛很是得意的说道。
“既然你能钻破地壳……”作家将心里的问题说出来。
“有一个地方的裂缝能把距离缩短到不到15公里。”张佛提示道。
作家说：“这仍然是一个巨大的障碍。”
张佛却说：“但不是不可逾越的，多年来我们一直在研究它。”
“即使……”作家还想说什么，但是傲慢的张佛已经不想听了。
他说：“抱歉，我已经被打断了。”说着他走回鱼缸那里继续往里放鱼食。
见他不理自己了，作家想了想还是上前说道：“但是教授？”
“嗯？”张佛没有抬头只是回问。
作家上前道：“既然你成功了，你也知道会发生什么，不是吗？”

张佛抬起头来问向作家：“你告诉我，作家。”
作家想了想说：“水会变成过热的蒸汽，压力会增大，并使地壳破裂。毁灭所有的生命，甚至毁灭地球。”
密闭的房间里空气凝滞死寂，没有一丝风，也没有半点多余的声响，唯有张佛低沉偏执的话音缓缓回荡，字字落地都带着一种近乎癫狂的郑重：“没错，我会兑现我曾经许下的诺言，将那座长久沉沦于深海暗渊、被巨浪与黑暗禁锢千年的亚特王朝彻底解救出来。我会亲手将它从无尽海底托起，缓缓抬升，直抵辽阔苍穹之上，让整座古老王朝凌驾于天地之间，那一幕盛景，必将震撼寰宇，举世无双。”
张佛双目骤然圆睁，眼球微微凸起，眼底布满亢奋的红血丝，眼神迷离恍惚，却又透着一股极致偏执的笃定。他像是深陷自我编织的狂热梦境之中，自顾自低声呓语，每一个字都说得格外用力，嗓音微微发颤，浑身流淌着近乎走火入魔的疯癫气息。
一旁的作家静静伫立在原地，目光紧紧锁着眼前状态诡异失常的张佛，眼底藏着难以察觉的凝重与警惕。他沉默片刻，缓缓抬起双手，指尖紧绷，而后骤然发力，重重拍击在一起。
“啪！”一声清脆利落的掌声骤然撕裂死寂的空气，在空旷密闭的房间里反复回荡，带出细碎的回音，格外突兀。
紧接着又是两声连贯的脆响接连落下：“啪啪啪！”
掌声未落，张佛像是被这声响彻底点燃了心底的疯魔，身形微微震颤，肩头不受控制地轻抖，猛地抬高声调高声嘶吼起来，语气滚烫而狂热，裹挟着极致的偏执与野心：“这就是一切！这就是所有问题的终极答案！”
作家迅速收敛了脸上细微的神色，压下心底翻涌的忌惮、疑惑与不安，刻意放柔了语调，装作全然附和的模样，小心翼翼地开口试探，暗中套取对方埋藏心底的真实图谋：“你说得没错，的确是这样。只是我心中尚存一个小小的疑问——既然你想要复兴亚特王朝，为何偏偏要选择彻底炸毁、覆灭这个世界？”

content_en:
Seeing him being so evasive and completely unwilling to pay attention to himself, the writer stood there, pondering over and over again in his heart for a long time. He knew that this matter was related to all living things and the survival of the entire planet, and there was no room for any slackness or indulgence. In the end, he suppressed the hesitation in his heart, took a step forward, and interrupted the leisurely peace again: "But Professor?"
"Huh?" Zhang Fo still didn't raise his head, his eyes were still firmly fixed on the fish swimming in the tank, and his fingertips were still spreading fish food slowly, and he only gave a light response casually, without caring about the writer's concerns at all.
Seeing this, the writer took half a step forward again. The atmosphere around him completely calmed down, and his expression became extremely solemn. Every word was spoken clearly and forcefully, with a heavy warning, and he asked in a deep voice: "If you really succeed in implementing this plan, you clearly know what devastating consequences will follow, don't you?"
This heavy question finally made Zhang Fo stop what he was doing. He slowly raised his eyes, raised his head, and locked his gaze directly on the writer in front of him. There was a bit of scrutiny, a bit of playfulness, and a hint of almost paranoid confidence in his eyes. He asked unhurriedly: "Then tell me, writer, what will happen?"
The writer took a deep breath, his chest was swollen and heavy, his mind was rapidly deducing the chain of disasters caused by this crazy plan, and his heart was filled with chills. He looked at the arrogant man in front of him, his tone became more solemn and solemn, and he said with heart-wrenching words: "A large amount of seawater suddenly pours into the extremely hot core area underground, and will be vaporized in an instant, turning into ultra-high temperature and ultra-high pressure superheated steam. The pressure in the underground confined space will skyrocket crazily in a short period of time, layer by layer. , finally breaking through the limit of the rock formation, forcefully cracking and collapsing the entire earth's crust. At that time, mountains and rivers will overturn, the earth will collapse, seas of fire will rage, and the world will undergo drastic changes. All living things in the world will be wiped out, and no one will be spared. This blue planet we live on will also completely collapse and be destroyed. "
(“Yes, but you don’t have sewers big enough to hold the ocean,” the writer said, looking at the sandbox model.
"Then I will make one." Zhang Fo said.
The writer asked in confusion: "Sorry, I'm a little confused. The earth's crust is so thick, and underneath it is considered to be a white-hot molten core. So where are you going to take the ocean?"
Zhang Fo said proudly: "This is my secret."
"Oh, you are making fun of me, professor." The writer said hypocritically.
"No, no." Zhang Fo said proudly.
"Since you can drill through the earth's crust..." The writer expressed the question in his heart.
"There is a crack in one place that can shorten the distance to less than 15 kilometers." Zhang Fo reminded.
"That remains a huge hurdle," the writer said.
Zhang Fo said: "But it is not insurmountable. We have been studying it for many years."
"Even if..." The writer wanted to say something else, but the arrogant Zhang Fo no longer wanted to hear it.
He said, "Sorry, I've been interrupted." Then he walked back to the fish tank and continued to put fish food in it.
Seeing that he ignored her, the writer thought for a while and stepped forward and said, "But Professor?"
"Huh?" Zhang Fo just replied without raising his head.
The writer stepped forward and said: "Now that you succeed, you also know what will happen, don't you?"
Zhang Fo raised his head and asked the writer: "Tell me, writer."
The writer thought for a while and said: "The water will turn into superheated steam, the pressure will increase, and the earth's crust will rupture. Destroy all life, and even destroy the earth."
The air in the airtight room was stagnant and silent, without a trace of wind or any extra sound. Only Zhang Fo's low and paranoid voice slowly echoed, and every word was spoken with an almost crazy solemnity: "Yes, I will fulfill the promise I once made and turn the long-sinking buildingThe At Dynasty, which had been imprisoned in the dark abyss of the deep sea for thousands of years by huge waves and darkness, was completely rescued. I will lift it up from the bottom of the ocean with my own hands, slowly lift it up to the vast sky, and let the entire ancient dynasty tower over the sky and the earth. That scene will surely shock the world and be unparalleled. "
Zhang Fo's eyes suddenly widened, his eyeballs bulged slightly, and his eyes were filled with excited red bloodshot eyes. His eyes were blurred, but they also revealed an extremely paranoid determination. He seemed to be deep in a feverish dream he had spun, murmuring to himself, speaking every word with extra force, his voice trembling slightly, and an almost obsessive madness flowing through his body.
The writer on the side stood quietly, his eyes tightly locked on Zhang Fo, who was in a strange and abnormal state in front of him. There was an imperceptible solemnity and vigilance in his eyes. He was silent for a moment, then slowly raised his hands, tightening his fingertips, and then suddenly exerted force and slapped them together hard.
"Crack! "A clear and crisp applause suddenly tore through the dead air, echoing repeatedly in the empty and sealed room, bringing out tiny echoes that were particularly abrupt.
Immediately afterwards, there were two consecutive crisp sounds: "Pah, pah, pah!" "
Before the applause ended, Zhang Fo seemed to be completely ignited by the sound, and the madness in his heart was completely ignited. His body trembled slightly, his shoulders shook uncontrollably, he suddenly raised his voice and roared loudly, his tone was hot and fanatical, wrapped in the ultimate paranoia and ambition: "This is everything! This is the ultimate answer to all your questions! "
The writer quickly calmed down the subtle expression on his face, suppressed the fear, doubts and uneasiness surging in his heart, deliberately softened his tone, pretended to agree completely, and cautiously opened his mouth to test, secretly trying to get the other party's true intentions buried deep in his heart: "You are right, it is indeed like this. But there is still a small doubt in my mind - since you want to revive the At Dynasty, why do you choose to completely blow up and destroy this world? "
